newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Tongkah gets offer for broker stake.
newsitem.headline: Tongkah gets offer for broker stake.

text.p: Malaysian diversified firm Tongkah Holdings Bhd has been approached to sell its 75 percent stake in stockbroking firm Kestrel Securities Sdn Bhd, The Star newspaper reported on Saturday.
It quoted Tongkah executive director Yeow Kheng Chew, who said the company had held talks but that they were "very preliminary." He did not name the interested buyer.
"We may consider selling our stake if the price is right but we are not committed (at this juncture), but it is worth a thought," Yeow told the newspaper.
Yeow also said that if Tongkah decides to sell its stake in Kestrel, it would have to get "300 million ringgit and above."
"It will be too good to resist if the price is right and we can then use the proceeds from the sale to expand our other businesses," Yeow told the daily.
Tongkah is also involved in seismic data processing, property development, making printed circuit boards and plastic injection moulding.
